en.title: Australia Passes NDIS Amendment Bill 2026 to Strengthen Disability Support
en.summary: The Australian Parliament passed the NDIS Amendment Bill 2026, aiming to make the National Disability Insurance Scheme stronger, fairer and more sustainable. In related news, U.S. Senator Jeanne Shaheen announced federal funding for affordable housing in Salem and healthcare accessibility in Nashua. Additionally, Miami University launched GrackleScan, a new accessibility tool, while UNESCO Japan promoted social inclusion programs and San Francisco reopened its small business accessibility grant.

highlights.title: Shaheen Highlights Federal Funding Secured for Affordable Housing in Salem and Health Care Accessibility in Nashua
New accessibility tool: GrackleScan - Miami University
UNESCO Japan Supports Social Inclusion and Disability Welfare
San Francisco Restarts Small Business Accessibility Facilities Grant, Up to $10,000 per Business

zh-TW.title: 澳洲通過NDIS修正案2026 年，旨在加強殘障支援與永續發展
zh-TW.summary: 澳洲議會通過了NDIS修正案2026，旨在使國家殘障保險計畫更強大、公平且永續。美國參議員謝恩宣佈為薩勒姆的可負擔住房和納舒亞的醫療可及性爭取聯邦資金。此外，邁阿密大學推出新無障礙工具GrackleScan，聯合國教科文組織日本推動社會包容計畫，舊金山重啟小商業無障礙設施補助金。
